舞台左箱，并承诺首演前修好断弦琴；左箱盖上的白线是取弦标记。剧场规约写明：断弦琴换上完整琴弦并试音后才可登台。幕布下缘缀着蓝色流苏。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"染布工另给窗帘染色，窗帘不用于首演，也不影响琴弦。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-52C0","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Abfa55d4c-d328-4bb4-a265-b51e72c6eb36:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:bfa55d4c-d328-4bb4-a265-b51e72c6eb36"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["染布工另给窗帘染色，窗帘不用于首演，也不影响琴弦。"]},{"documentId":"D5","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"贺弦换弦并完成试音，修琴承诺兑现，白线标记得到回收；温宁仍依据旧消息去右箱寻找替弦。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-52C0","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Aefa8ae45-f93d-4168-80d0-d1f6eaeee835:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:efa8ae45-f93d-4168-80d0-d1f6eaeee835"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["贺弦换弦并完成试音，修琴承诺兑现，白线标记得到回收；温宁仍依据旧消息去右箱寻找替弦。"]},{"documentId":"D6","title":"温宁","kind":"entity","text":"温宁","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"温宁","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:7a25da6e-604e-4464-adfa-6a2fd8830b56","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["温宁"]},{"documentId":"D7","title":"贺弦","kind":"entity","text":"贺弦","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"贺弦","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:dfa7f79a-1c5a-4c1c-be20-57824d9a9f67","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["贺弦"]}]}
